scenes.name: THREE CHOICES
lines: Choose stations so that every station is selected or next to a selected station. This is a dominating set.
选择一些站点，让每个站点自己被选中，或邻接被选中的站点。这就是支配集。
On a single edge, either end alone works, and choosing both ends works too.
一条边有三个合法选择：只选任意一端，或者两端都选。
Give a choice of size k the weight x to the k. The polynomial is two x plus x squared. At minus four, its value is eight.
选中 k 个点就给权重 x 的 k 次方。多项式为二 x 加 x 平方，在负四处的值为八。

scenes.name: THE CONNECTEDNESS OBSTACLE
lines: Alikhani and Griswold supplied a connected thirty-three vertex graph H whose domination polynomial vanishes at minus four.
Alikhani 与 Griswold 给出一个三十三点连通图 H，其支配多项式在负四处为零。
Separate copies multiply the polynomial, but they are disconnected. Adding an arbitrary edge can create new dominating choices.
分离的副本使多项式相乘，但图不连通。随意加边可能产生新的支配集。
For two isolated vertices, both must be selected. Add an edge, and either singleton suddenly works. We need a protected attachment point.
两个孤立点必须全部选中。加边后，只选一端也突然合法。我们需要一个受到保护的连接点。

scenes.name: THE LEAF MECHANISM
lines: A leaf w has just one neighbor, its support v. To cover the leaf, select w or select v.
叶子 w 只有一个邻居，即支撑点 v。要覆盖叶子，必须选 w 或选 v。
Either way, the support is already covered inside its own piece. Now join only supports in different pieces.
无论哪种情况，支撑点都已在自己的零件中被覆盖。现在只连接不同零件的支撑点。
Restrict any dominating choice to one piece. The leaf covers the support internally, and every other vertex has no outside neighbor. Restriction and union undo each other.
把整图的支配集限制到一个零件：叶子保证支撑点被内部覆盖，其他顶点没有外部邻居。限制与合并恰好互相撤销。

scenes.name: ONE COPY, ONE FACTOR
lines: In H, vertex five is a leaf next to vertex four. Join the copies of vertex four along a path.
在 H 中，顶点五是顶点四旁的叶子。将各副本的顶点四沿路径连接。
The graph becomes connected, while the entire polynomial stays the product. With r copies there are thirty-three r vertices.
图变得连通，而整个多项式仍是各零件的乘积。r 份副本共有三十三 r 个顶点。
The original root is simple, so the new root has multiplicity exactly r. Supports gain at most two neighbors, keeping maximum degree seven.
原来的根是单根，因此新图中根的重数恰为 r。支撑点至多增加两个邻居，最大度保持为七。

scenes.name: EVERY ORDER AT LEAST 35
lines: To fill the gaps between multiples of thirty-three, start with one H and attach single edges or three-vertex paths through their supports.
要填补三十三倍数之间的空隙，从一份 H 开始，通过支撑点连接单边或三点路径。
These pieces add two or three vertices. Their values at minus four are eight and minus twenty, so the root stays simple.
这些零件分别增加两点或三点。在负四处的值为八和负二十，所以原来的单根保持不变。
Every increment of at least two is a sum of twos and threes. This gives every order at least thirty-five, with maximum degree seven and cycle rank four.
每个至少为二的增量都能写成若干个二与三的和。因此每个至少三十五的阶都有例子，最大度七、循环秩四。

scenes.name: THE EXACT FORMAL CONCLUSION
lines: The pinned Lean theorem proves that beyond every size threshold there is a connected graph whose ordinary domination polynomial vanishes at minus four.
所引 Lean 定理证明：超过任意大小上界，都存在一个连通图，其普通支配多项式在负四处为零。
Its proof uses an extra hub and leaf. The path family, exact multiplicities, and every-order refinement have the paper's separate written proofs.
该形式证明使用额外中心点和叶子。路径族、精确重数及每阶细化在论文中有各自的书面证明。
The idea is small: a leaf makes an outside connection unnecessary for domination. That lets one known root survive in arbitrarily large connected graphs.
核心想法很小：叶子让支配不再需要借助外部连接。这就使一个已知根保留在任意大的连通图中。
